title: build(tsconfig): split the shared base out of the root tsconfig (#26092 part 1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9LfZ5QdBw85EmeKfVNFm1YF)_
Part of #26092 (PR 1 of 2: the tsconfig half; the vitest preset follows as PR 2).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`tsconfig.base.json`** (new) holds the compiler options the root `tsconfig.json` used to carry, unchanged. The 72 package/app/example configs that extended the root now extend it.
- **Root `tsconfig.json`** is now only the type-check program for `scripts/` and the top-level configs: it extends the base, adds `types: ["node"]`, keeps its `exclude`.
- **`tsconfig.test.base.json`** (new) holds the vitest module semantics (`noEmit`, `module: esnext`, `moduleResolution: bundler`, `lib: ["ES2022"]`). 36 of the 42 `tsconfig.test.json` files now spell `"extends": ["./tsconfig.json", "REL/tsconfig.test.base.json"]` and keep only what differs (`DOM` in `lib`, `types`). The other 6 do not re-set module semantics this way and are untouched.
- **Module re-sets:** the two configs that re-set `NodeNext` identically to the base (`packages/adapters/hono`, `packages/qa/http-conformance`) drop the duplicate; the seven `ES2020`/`bundler` configs keep it with a one-line reason (four drivers: no `"type": "module"`, so NodeNext compiles their sources as CommonJS and refuses `import.meta`, TS1470 measured; `embedder-openai` / `knowledge-memory` / `knowledge-ragflow`: tsup-bundled, no `"type": "module"`).
- **turbo.json** `globalDependencies` gains both bases, so a change to either invalidates every cached build the way a change to the root did; **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** `core:` filter lists both verbatim, which `check-ci-filter-parity` requires (measured: FAIL naming both files without these two lines).
- **Ledgers:** the three empty `test-typecheck-debt.json` files (`packages/rest`, `packages/client`, `packages/plugins/knowledge-ragflow`) are deleted (`check-test-typecheck.mts` reads a missing ledger as empty); the graduation history inside the empty `TEST_DEBT` object is deleted, keeping the closed-ledger rule.
- **Comments:** 63 mentions of "the root config" across 53 tsconfig comments now say "the base config".

## No semantic change, measured

`tsc --showConfig -p FILE` for every non-ui `tsconfig*.json` (143 files), before (main 95294be3) and after: **142 byte-identical**, file lists included. The root differs by exactly `types: ["node"]`. Strictness is not loosened anywhere.

## The card's premise on the root DEBT entry does not hold

Root program errors, `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` with the import closure built: **26 before, 26 after** `types: ["node"]`. The TS2591/TS2584 pile the entry's note blamed on the missing Node types was already gone. What stands: `scripts/analytics-reconcile` imports `@objectstack/*` and example sources the root program cannot resolve (TS2307 x17, plus TS7006 x7 they cascade into), `Object.hasOwn` under lib ES2020 in `scripts/check-test-typecheck.mts` (TS2550), and an unused local in `examples/app-showcase` pulled in by import (TS6133). So the `@objectstack/spec-monorepo` DEBT entry stays at 26 and its note is rewritten to that composition (the stale `compositionAt: 80` is dropped). Graduating it also needs a `typecheck:root` script and its step in `.github/workflows/lint.yml`: separate work, not in this PR. The card's acceptance line about deleting the entry is not met by design.

## Landing

Tier H: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is a governed surface, so this needs the maintainer's approval. The maintainer chose this shape (one PR carrying the two filter lines) on the thread decision card. Root `ci.yml` is also under a short hold for other in-flight work; land after that clears.

## Verification (head 07de412e3c)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived **117** commands on this head; all 117 ran, each exit captured before any pipe: **117 exit 0**. `--ran` reconciliation: 117 derived, 117 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Earlier on this branch five of them first refused on prerequisites (exit 2/3: shallow clone, unbuilt dists); after `git fetch --unshallow` and a build of every non-ui package they ran and exited 0, and they are in the 117 above.
- `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`: FAIL without the two ci.yml lines, exit 0 with them.
- `turbo run typecheck --force` over rest, client, knowledge-ragflow (the three deleted ledgers, whose `typecheck` runs `check:test-typecheck`), core, driver-sql, hono, http-conformance, spec: 49/49 tasks successful (before the main merge; the merge touched no non-ui tsconfig).
- Effective-config diff: see above. `tsc -b` was not used for the before/after count: the root config has no `noEmit` or `outDir`, so `tsc -b` would emit next to `scripts/`; the count is `tsc --noEmit -p`, which is what `check:type-check-debt` measures.
- Changed lines: well under the 3000 human-merge threshold. No changeset: no published package ships a tsconfig, and every package's effective compiler configuration is unchanged (`skip-changeset`).

## Acceptance notes

- `os create --in-repo` (`rootTsconfigExtends` in `packages/cli/src/commands/create.ts`) still points new in-repo scaffolds at the root `tsconfig.json`, which is now the scripts program, so a new scaffold would inherit `types: ["node"]` and the root `exclude`. Not changed here (outside this card's file surface); the CLI tests pin the root path.
- `packages/drivers/driver-memory/tsconfig.json` sets `noUnusedLocals: false`, a pre-existing loosening against the base; untouched.
- `embedder-openai`, `knowledge-memory`, `knowledge-ragflow` type-check with 0 errors under NodeNext, so their `bundler` re-set could be dropped later; kept here to keep the change semantics-free.
- The deleted `packages/rest` ledger's `_note` carried a re-derivation grep for `any`-typed response fixtures; it is in git history.
